definitions.gloss: early spring; the beginning of spring
definitions.explanation: The first part of spring, roughly February to early March in Japan, when it is still cold but the first signs of spring appear. A written and literary word.

examples.japanese: {早春|そうしゅん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訪|たず}ねた→訪ねる：01182_tazuneru⟧。
examples.english: I visited Kyoto in early spring.
The plum is a flower that blooms in early spring.

examples.japanese: {早春|そうしゅん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}っていた→残る：01187_nokoru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{日差|ひざ}し→日差し：00107_hizashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{確|たし}か→確か：00894_tashika⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ものだった。
examples.english: Snow still lay on the early-spring mountains, but the sunlight was unmistakably that of spring.

notes:
Sino-Japanese compound of {早|そう} (early) + {春|しゅん} (spring). It belongs to writing: guidebooks, news, poetry, and the opening lines of formal letters. In conversation people say ⟦{春先|はるさき}→春先：32303_harusaki⟧ or ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{初|はじ}め→初め：02931_hajime⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {早春|そうしゅん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{候|こう}: in this early spring season (opening of a formal letter in February or March)
- {早春|そうしゅん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧: early-spring flowers
- {早春|そうしゅん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧: the winds of early spring

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{春先|はるさき}→春先：32303_harusaki⟧: early spring — the everyday spoken word
- ⟦{初春|しょしゅん}→初春：21709_shoshun⟧: early spring; also the New Year in greetings
- ⟦{晩春|ばんしゅん}→晩春：13093_banshun⟧: late spring — the opposite end of the season
